steps.instruction: Separate 4 eggs into whites and yolks.
Stir the egg yolks, 1 1/2 cups of flour and 1 1/4 cups of milk in a bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of salt, and stir until the clumps are gone.
Beat the egg whites in a different bowl until stiff peaks form.
Add the beaten egg whites to the other bowl.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a flat pan on high heat.
Add the batter to the pan and cook it on both sides.
Put the pan in the oven for 10 minutes, until lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Put the pan in the oven for around 10 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.

steps.instruction: Cut the dough into bite-sized pieces with a spatula.
Sprinkle a little sugar and the raisins on top.
